From Kraft Work · Price: touch only, and anything you fix also stops your stand's hand.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: an object your stand touches stops in place (it can't move, even in the air) until you release it as a free action or for 1 minute. Or your stand fixes a limb of a creature it touches (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round on a failure; also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round on a critical failure. Once per turn your stand can do this as part of a Strike (1 action) against the creature it hits. Stopped objects keep stored momentum: 1 action, release a stopped object at a creature within 30 ft of your stand for @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 5: Reaction: stop a projectile that would hit you or an ally within 30 ft of your stand (Interact); the ranged Strike misses. A creature that fails against your limb fix is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round, and one that critically fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute. Surge: a creature your stand hits is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 9: Your surge can fix up to two creatures your stand hits this turn (one save each).
  • 13: Releasing a stopped object deals 2D force damage.
  • 17: Immobilize for 1 minute on a critical failure.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
